name: Account takeover
description: A user or service account is being used by someone else: cut the sessions, find what they reached.
author: kubesoc
summary:
Account:
First suspicious sign-in:
Source IPs / ASN:
MFA state:
What the account can reach:

tasks.title: Confirm the takeover
tasks.description: Compare sign-in locations, user agents and times against the user's normal pattern. Ask the user directly. Add the source IPs as ip-src IOCs.

tasks.title: Revoke sessions and reset credentials
tasks.description: In Keycloak: log out all sessions, reset the password, revoke refresh tokens and application passwords, re-enrol MFA. Record the time - everything after it is the attacker's, everything before is evidence.

tasks.title: Review what the account did
tasks.description: Mail rules and forwarding, OAuth grants, API tokens, group memberships, data downloads. Add each finding as a case event.

tasks.title: Triage the endpoints the account signed in from
tasks.description: If a company endpoint was used, tag its asset velociraptor:contain:triage and approve, to rule out an infostealer on the device.

tasks.title: Isolate the endpoint if malware is found
tasks.description: Tag velociraptor:contain:isolate and approve; add the sample's SHA-256 as an IOC and tag velociraptor:contain:quarantine-file.

tasks.title: Hunt for the same source across other accounts
tasks.description: Search the SIEM for the attacker's IPs, ASN and user agent over the last 90 days across all accounts of this tenant.

tasks.title: Close-out
tasks.description: Was MFA enabled, was it phishable, which control would have stopped it. Record the decision.
